# Concepts

<!-- portable-kb:index:start -->
* [Deterministic validation](deterministic-validation.md) - Deterministic validation reports the same ordered governance findings for the same bundle, schema, date, and base.
* [Immutable knowledge identity](immutable-knowledge-identity.md) - A knowledge item's UUID remains constant while its readable path may change.
* [Material change](material-change.md) - A material change alters what a reader may believe or do and therefore invalidates prior verification.
* [Portable knowledge bundle](portable-knowledge-bundle.md) - A portable knowledge bundle keeps canonical knowledge in readable files independent of its consumers.
* [Verification is evidence](verification-is-evidence.md) - Verification records a scoped check of one snapshot rather than declaring permanent truth.
<!-- portable-kb:index:end -->
